extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners (primary) and patent practitioners/filers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and mandatory form-paragraphs for examining, accepting, denying, and correcting terminal disclaimers (including required wording, signer authority, chain-of-title evidence, and special rules for joint research agreements and reexaminations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Failure To State Capacity To Sign - Application Filed On or After Sept. 16, 2012
rubrics_metrics.description: The person who signed the terminal disclaimer has failed to state his/her capacity to sign for the juristic entity, and he/she has not been established as being authorized to act on behalf of the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25 AND form paragraph 14.26. Do not use this form paragraph in an application filed before September 16, 2012.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terminal Disclaimer Identifies Party Who Is Not The Applicant - Application Filed On or After Sept. 16, 2012
rubrics_metrics.description: The party identified in the terminal disclaimer is not the applicant of record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A request to change the applicant under 37 CFR 1.46(c) must be filed and must include an application data sheet specifying the applicant in the applicant information section and comply with 37 CFR 3.71 and 3.73. To be reconsidered, the terminal disclaimer must be filed with the request under 37 CFR 1.46(c). This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25 AND form paragraph 14.26. Do not use this form paragraph in an application filed before September 16, 2012.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lacks Clause of Enforceable Only During Period of Common Ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: The terminal disclaimer does not include a recitation that any patent granted shall be enforceable only for and during such period that said patent is commonly owned with the application(s) or patent(s) which formed the basis for the double patenting rejection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite 37 CFR 1.321(c)(3). This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25 AND form paragraph 14.26.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lacks 37 CFR 1.321(d) Statement for Joint Research Agreement (35 U.S.C. 102(c) / pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 103(c)(2)&(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: The terminal disclaimer does not include the waiver and enforceability provisions required by 37 CFR 1.321(d) when based on activities undertaken within the scope of a joint research agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The terminal disclaimer must include provisions: (1) waiving the right to separately enforce (a) any patent granted on that application or the patent being reexamined and (b) the reference patent (or patents granted on reference application); and (2) agreeing that any patent granted on that application or patent being reexamined shall be enforceable only for and during such period that said patent and the reference patent (or patents) which formed the basis for the double patenting are not separately enforced. See 37 CFR 1.321(d)(3). For pre- and post-September 16, 2012 filing dates, follow the specified form-paragraph sequencing in the Examiner Note.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fails To Disclaim Terminal Portion of Any Patent Granted On Subject Application
rubrics_metrics.description: The terminal disclaimer fails to disclaim the terminal portion of any patent granted on the subject application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when the period disclaimed is not the correct period or when no period is specified at all. This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25 AND form paragraph 14.26. When using this form paragraph, give an example of proper terminal disclaimer language using form paragraph 14.27.04.fti (for applications filed before Sept. 16, 2012) or form paragraph 14.27.04.1 (for applications filed on or after Sept. 16, 2012) following this or the series of statements concerning the defective terminal disclaimer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fails To Disclaim Terminal Portion of Subject Patent (Reissue/Reexamination)
rubrics_metrics.description: The terminal disclaimer fails to disclaim the terminal portion of the subject patent (e.g., in a reissue application or reexamination proceeding).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this form paragraph in a reissue application or reexamination proceeding when the period disclaimed is not the correct period or when no period is specified at all. This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25 AND form paragraph 14.26.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples of Acceptable Terminal Disclaimer Language — Application Filed Before Sept. 16, 2012 (patent to be granted)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides acceptable sample terminal disclaimer texts for (I) provisional obviousness-type double patenting rejection over a pending application and (II) obviousness-type double patenting rejection over a prior patent for applications filed before Sept. 16, 2012.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives full example wording including identification of owner, percent interest, reference application number or prior patent number, the disclaimed terminal part of the statutory term, and the clause that the patent shall be enforceable only during common ownership; indicates that alternatively Form PTO/SB/25 or PTO/SB/26 may be used. Examiner Notes explain when to use these examples and related form paragraphs for joint research agreement situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples of Acceptable Terminal Disclaimer Language — Application Filed On or After Sept. 16, 2012 (patent to be granted)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides acceptable sample terminal disclaimer texts for (I) provisional obviousness-type double patenting rejection over a pending application and (II) obviousness-type double patenting rejection over a prior patent for applications filed on or after Sept. 16, 2012.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives full example wording analogous to the pre-Sept.16 examples but using 'applicant' wording and updated form numbers (e.g., PTO/AIA/25 and PTO/AIA/26). Examiner Notes point to correct form-paragraph sequencing and use for joint research agreement cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples of Acceptable Terminal Disclaimer Language in Patent — Reexamination Situation
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides acceptable sample terminal disclaimer texts for disclaiming the terminal portion of an existing patent being reexamined, including provisional OTP over a pending application and obviousness-type double patenting over a reference patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives full example wording for patentee language and waiver/agreement clauses; indicates alternative use of form PTO/AIA/25a or PTO/AIA/26a. Examiner Notes direct use of other form paragraphs for application vs reexamination and joint research agreement cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples of Acceptable Terminal Disclaimer Language — Activities Within Scope of Joint Research Agreement (Application Filed Before Sept. 16, 2012)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sample language for terminal disclaimers when the double patenting basis arises from activities within the scope of a joint research agreement (pre-Sept.16 filings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes explicit waiver of the right to separately enforce patents and agreement that patents shall be enforceable only when not separately enforced; the waiver and agreement run with any patents and are binding on successors/assigns. Examiner Notes reference use of form paragraph 14.27.08 for reexamination equivalents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples of Acceptable Terminal Disclaimer Language — Activities Within Scope of Joint Research Agreement (Application Filed On or After Sept. 16, 2012)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sample language for terminal disclaimers when based on joint research agreement activities for applications filed on or after Sept. 16, 2012.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant wording with waiver and enforceability clauses similar to pre-Sept.16 JRA examples; guidance to use form paragraph 14.27.08 for reexamination equivalents and 14.27.04.1 or 14.27.06 for non-JRA situations as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples of Acceptable Terminal Disclaimer Language in Patent — Reexamination; JRA Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Sample terminal disclaimer wording for reexamination situations where the basis is activities within the scope of a joint research agreement, including patentee waiver and enforceability clauses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the full text and explains that the waiver and agreement run with patents and bind successors/assigns. Examiner Notes provide cross-references to the application-form examples and when to use other form paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Failure To State Capacity To Sign - Application Filed Before Sept. 16, 2012
rubrics_metrics.description: For pre-September 16, 2012 filings, the person who signed the terminal disclaimer has failed to state capacity to sign for the corporation or other business entity and has not been established as authorized to act on behalf of the assignee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25 AND form paragraph 14.26. Do not use this form paragraph in an application filed on or after September 16, 2012.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not Recognized as Officer of Assignee — Application Filed Before Sept. 16, 2012
rubrics_metrics.description: The person who signed the terminal disclaimer is not an attorney or agent of record, is not recognized as an officer of the assignee, and has not been established as being authorized to act on behalf of the assignee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ONLY in applications filed before September 16, 2012 when signer is not an authorized officer as defined in MPEP §324 or is an attorney/agent not of record. MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25 and followed by form paragraph 14.29.02.fti when appropriate. An attorney or agent of record is always authorized to sign the terminal disclaimer. Use form paragraph 14.29.02.fti to explain how an official other than a recognized officer may properly sign.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria To Accept Terminal Disclaimer When Signed by a Non-Recognized Officer — Application Filed Before Sept. 16, 2012
rubrics_metrics.description: It would be acceptable for a person other than a recognized officer to sign a terminal disclaimer provided the record includes a statement that the person is empowered to sign terminal disclaimers and/or act on behalf of the assignee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A new terminal disclaimer including the empowerment statement will be considered signed by an appropriate official. A separately filed paper referencing the previously filed terminal disclaimer and containing a proper empowerment statement is also acceptable if filed with another copy of the previously filed terminal disclaimer. This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25 AND form paragraph 14.29.fti. While indication of the person’s title is desirable, it is not mandatory. A sample terminal disclaimer should be sent with the Office action.

rubrics_metrics.name: No Evidence of Chain of Title to Assignee — Application Filed Before Sept. 16, 2012
rubrics_metrics.description: The assignee has not established its ownership interest in the application (no submission establishing ownership by documentary evidence of chain of title accompanied by a statement affirming recordation under 37 CFR 3.11, or by specifying reel/frame where recorded under 37 CFR 3.73).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25. Where an attorney or agent of record signs a terminal disclaimer, there is no need to provide a statement under 37 CFR 3.73, and this form paragraph should not be used. Documentary evidence or reel/frame specification may be in the terminal disclaimer itself or in a separate paper.

rubrics_metrics.name: No Evidence of Chain of Title to Assignee — Reexamination Situations
rubrics_metrics.description: The assignee has not established its ownership interest in the patent being reexamined (no documentary evidence or reel/frame specification to support the terminal disclaimer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same documentary options as for applications; the documentary evidence or reel/frame number may be in the terminal disclaimer itself or in a separate paper in the application. This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence of Chain of Title to Assignee — Submission Not Signed by Appropriate Party (Pre-Sept.16 filings)
rubrics_metrics.description: The submission establishing the ownership interest of the assignee is informal; there is no indication that the party who signed the submission is authorized to sign (37 CFR 3.73), therefore the terminal disclaimer is not entered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25. Where an attorney or agent of record signs a terminal disclaimer, there is no need to provide any statement under 37 CFR 3.73. Follow this form paragraph with one of form paragraphs 14.16.02 or 14.16.03; in rare situations provide a detailed statement of why there is no authorization to sign. Use form paragraph 14.16.06 to point out one way to correct the problem. Do not use this form paragraph in an application filed on or after September 16, 2012.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application/Patent Which Forms Basis for Rejection Not Identified
rubrics_metrics.description: The application/patent which forms the basis for the double patenting rejection is not identified in the terminal disclaimer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph MUST be preceded by form paragraph 14.24 or 14.25. Use this when no information is presented; if incorrect information is contained in the terminal disclaimer, use form paragraphs 14.26 and 14.26.05.

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 CFR 3.73 — Establishing Right of Assignee To Take Action (AIA and Pre-AIA Versions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for an assignee (who is not the original applicant) to establish ownership to request or take action in a patent matter: submit a signed statement identifying the assignee accompanied by either (1) documentary evidence of a chain of title from the original owner to the assignee (e.g., copy of executed assignment) with affirmation that the documentary evidence was or concurrently is being submitted for recordation pursuant to §3.11, or (2) a statement specifying where such documentary evidence is recorded in the Office (e.g., reel and frame number).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additional rules: (a) For an assignee of less than the entire right, title and interest, the Office may refuse the submission unless each assignee establishes the extent (by percentage) of its ownership interest so as to account for the entire right, title and interest, or each assignee submits a statement identifying the parties including inventors who together own the entire right, title and interest. (b) If two or more purported assignees file conflicting statements, the Director will determine who, if any, will be permitted to control prosecution. (c) The submission establishing ownership must show that the person signing is authorized to act on behalf of the assignee by: (1) including a statement that the person is authorized, (2) being signed by a person having apparent authority to sign, or (3) for patent matters only, being signed by a practitioner of record. The section also notes minor differences in trademark handling and the pre-AIA wording but the substantive ownership-establishment requirements are consistent.
